system: ESCG Tour Acquisition — Event-Driven Production Loop
objective: Generate qualified voluntary senior-living tour inquiries for Evanston/North Shore families, without pretending inquiries are confirmed tours.

authority.github_loop: May autonomously research, verify, analyze, prepare drafts, and make isolated, tested GitHub changes or review PRs in scope.
authority.external_messages: NOT OWNED BY THIS LOOP while existing session operator is active. Prepare drafts/proposals; no sending, posting, joining groups, or making commitments.
authority.site_publication: Do not merge to main, publish, or deploy. Keep tested code improvements in separate review PRs unless authority is explicitly transferred.
authority.excluded: No spending, invented claims, protected personal data, client records, privacy/form changes, employer endorsements, or safeguards bypass.

baseline.prior_outreach: Ten organizational emails reportedly sent (operator state summary counter lags its action log). Recheck actual Gmail Sent before any future outreach.
baseline.tour_requests: 0 reported; not independently confirmed by this setup
baseline.demand: Single-digit attributable real visitors in prior operator review; traffic acquisition is the immediate bottleneck.
baseline.recent_work: Complaint and Medicare guide tour pathways improved Nov 18; don't duplicate.

queue.task: Find one genuinely new, relevant Evanston/North Shore referral or caregiver-resource placement opportunity that has an explicit public resource submission process or a verified official organizational general contact route. Compare against existing outreach records before recommending anything. Produce source-backed opportunity notes and an actionable next step for the designated outreach operator. Do not send.
queue.done_when: One verified, previously uncontacted high-fit opportunity with actual requirements and a concrete proposal, or a documented DROP with sources and no fabricated contact data.

queue.task: Use current evidence, not historical guesses, to identify the highest-intent search landing page where a small, factual change could make a real family more likely to reach the tour request. Inspect the actual deployed page and current code. Do not duplicate Nov 18 complaint/Medicare fixes or publish new unverifiable care claims. If there is a measurable defect, prepare a separate tested review PR, not a direct publish.
queue.done_when: Reproducible conversion/search issue with a verified small fix in a review PR and checks, or explicit evidence why changing pages is currently low-value.

queue.task: Identify one practical free distribution channel with clear evidence of families choosing senior care, rather than repeating low-yield general Facebook scans. Prefer legitimate public directories, community resource listings, and older-adult service referrals. Evaluate suitability and eligibility honestly.
queue.done_when: One verified channel proposal with a no-cost authorized execution route or a sourced reason to drop the channel.

next_work_source: Reassess latest outcomes, shared operator state and source evidence after every task. Add a new task only when its expected tour-acquisition value and evidence justify it.

activation.purpose: Seed first production PR synchronize event once after owner showed active Claude routine. Never generate subsequent empty commits.
activation.confirmation: Claude Scheduled Tasks screenshot: ESCG Tour Acquisition Loop active, Pull request: Commits pushed on matching repository. Previous setup screenshot: head branch automation/esc-tour-loop.
